props.name: leftActions
props.description: Action buttons revealed when swiping right (from left edge)

props.name: rightActions
props.description: Action buttons revealed when swiping left (from right edge)

props.name: actionWidth
props.description: Action button width in pixels (defaults to 76px per action button)

props.name: threshold
props.description: Minimum drag threshold in pixels to trigger row expansion (defaults to 40px)

props.name: fullSwipeToExecute
props.description: Execute the primary action automatically when full swipe threshold is reached

props.name: fullSwipeThreshold
props.description: Full swipe threshold in pixels or percentage of width (defaults to 180px)

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Callback fired when row snaps open

props.name: onClose
props.description: Callback fired when row returns to closed state
